title: 净明忠孝道收徒仪式
body: 丙午年正月十九日，美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新喜收净明忠孝道第二十七代弟子胡源明。为首位美国净明弟子，已明确师承，人神皆知。
body_en: On the 19th day of the 1st lunar month of the Bingwu year, President Ji Faxin of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America joyfully accepted Hu Yuanming (Jacob M. Bressman) as the 27th generation disciple of the Jingming Zhongxiao Dao lineage. As the first American Jingming disciple, the master-disciple lineage has been formally established, witnessed by both humans and deities.
